program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define objs (objects-multicolor g 0))
             (define (obj-pattern o)
               (define bb (obj-bbox o))
               (define r1 (first bb))
               (define c1 (second bb))
               (define r2 (third bb))
               (define c2 (fourth bb))
               (build-grid (+ 1 (- r2 r1))
                           (+ 1 (- c2 c1))
                           (r c)
                           (at g (+ r r1) (+ c c1))))
             (define patterns (map obj-pattern objs))
             (define (count-equal p ps) (count-if (lambda (q) (equal? p q)) ps))
             (find-first (lambda (p) (= (count-equal p patterns) 1)) patterns)))))
